title: Divided by discipline? A systematic literature review on the quantification of online sexism and misogyny using a semi-automated approach
reasoning: The paper is a systematic literature review focused on the computational detection of sexism and misogyny. While the subject matter is inherently tied to social values and ethics, the paper does not contain a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, theology, or general ethical frameworks beyond the context of gender bias and hate speech detection.
